lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Heinrich Jeon is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Heinrich Jeon is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Heinrich kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Heinrich's gone." Kambale looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Heinrich." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. LaToya blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Sewing & Textiles (Level 1). Mend tears so they hold: backstitch, small stitches, match the grain.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Heinrich Jeon, 41 days. The mantle passes to LaToya Young.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. LaToya Young, 23 — a tailor. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Bird Whisperer.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Heinrich — and Heinrich is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Renee, Kambale, Miguel and 1 more speak for LaToya — "Heinrich trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew LaToya before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
